items.evidence: play --ticks 5 with a fresh --settings printed one JSON object at screen title with tick, screen, menu_index, language, volume, difficulty, texts, score, best, coins, wave, gate_health, guard_y, quick, heavy, saved, enemies, bolts.
README's frame command (--ticks 700 --frame frame.png --size 800x480) wrote a PNG whose header reads 800 x 480; also my own frames in judge-scratch were 800 x 480.
Fresh place: texts [name, 'Best: 0', Start, Settings, Quit], no Continue; 5:enter -> tick 6 screen play, wave 1, score 0, coins 0, gate_health 10, first walker at x=20.

12 rights on Volume: 8 -> 10 and stays 10; 12 lefts -> 0 and stays 0. Language right: en -> es -> fr, a further right stays fr; Difficulty Normal by default, right -> Hard (stays), lefts -> Normal -> Easy (stays).

With language es and fr in kept settings, texts on title, settings, play, shop, paused, won and lost were all Spanish / French (e.g. 'Oleada 8 de 8', 'Prochaine vague : 8', 'Vous avez perdu', 'Intro: título'); only the game's name stayed English.
Run 1 set language es, difficulty easy, volume 5 in folder k5; run 2 with k5 started with es/5/easy at tick 1; a fresh folder k6 started en/8/normal.
Up held from tick 6: guard_y 6 -> 9 at tick 36 (0.1/tick = 6 u/s), 12 at 100 and stays 12; down held: reaches 0 and stays 0 at 290-300; x is 2 in the frame.
Shoot held from tick 66: bolts appear at ticks 67, 91, 115, 139 (every 24); each moves 0.2333/tick (14 u/s); the bolt at x=19.033 at tick 140 is gone by 150; bolts in lane y=0 pass walkers in lane 6.
Seed 3, no input: walkers enter at ticks 6, 96, 186, ... (90 ticks), 5 in all, in lanes 2,4,6,4,2, health 2, x drops 0.025/tick (1.5 u/s).
Seed 7: a bolt in lane 6 brings the walker's health to 1 and is gone (tick 80); the second hit removes it with score 0 -> 10 and coins 0 -> 1 (tick 110); a bolt in lane 0 passed lane-6 walkers.

No shooting: walker reaches x=0 at tick 806, at 807 it is gone, gate 10 -> 9, score and coins stay 0; in wave 2 gate reaches 0 and screen is lost with texts ['You lost','Final score: 0','Best: 0','Enter: title'].
Difficulty set to Easy then Start: gate_health 14 ('Puerta: 14'); set to Hard then Start: gate_health 7.

Last wave-1 walker gone at tick 1166 -> 1167 screen shop, texts ['Shop','Coins: 0','Next wave: 2','Quick hands: level 0 of 2, 5 coins','Heavy bolts: level 0 of 1, 12 coins','Mason: gate 5 of 10, 4 coins','Next wave']; guard_y stays 6 with up+shoot held, no bolts or enemies.
Coins 35 in shop: Quick hands bought -> 30 coins, level 1, bolt spacing 4.2 units (18 ticks) in play; bought again -> 20 coins, level 2, spacing 2.8 (12 ticks); third Enter left coins 20 and quick 2.
Heavy bolts bought (20 -> 8 coins, heavy 1); a second Enter left coins 8; in wave 2 a single bolt destroyed a 2-health walker (score 50 -> 60, coins +1).
Gate 5/10 with 10 coins: Mason -> gate 8, coins 6; again -> gate 10 (not 11), coins 2; again (full and too few coins) unchanged; gate 10/10 with 8 coins: unchanged; gate 5 with 0 coins: unchanged.
Next wave Enter acted at tick 1179 (screen play); first wave-2 walker appeared at 1239 (60 ticks later); 7 walkers in wave 2; texts 'Wave 2 of 8'.
Wave 3 (from a kept saved run at wave 2): 6 walkers then 4 runners every 72 ticks; runner health 1, x 20 -> 19.95 in a tick (3 u/s); a runner destroyed gave +15 points and +1 coin.
Wave 4: 8 walkers then 1 brute (health 6, 1/60 unit a tick); unhit at Easy it took gate 6 -> 3; with Heavy bolts it was destroyed by 3 bolts for +40 points and +3 coins.

modules/work/waves.json holds per wave walkers, runners, brutes, interval, read by lib.rs (include_str); README 'Changing a wave' says to edit it and rerun. Not tested by editing (no changes to the game).

A scripted run from Start through all 8 waves (seed 3) ended on won at tick 6400 with score 1540 = 1340 enemy points (46 walkers, 32 runners, 10 brutes) + 20 x 10 gate; Enter -> title. A saved-wave-7 Easy run also won with 1660 = 1380 + 280.

Escape pauses (enemies, bolts and guard frozen ticks 101-199) and Resume continues from the same state; but Title from the pause gives screen 'bounce' (not title), with enemies still in the state, and its Start resumes the saved run's shop instead of a new run.
saved false during wave 1, true at the shop; next run with the same folder showed texts [..., Start, Continue, Settings, Quit].

Saved after buying Quick hands (score 50, coins 0, quick 1, wave 1); next process: Continue -> shop with score 50, coins 0, gate 10, quick 1, 'Next wave: 2'; Next wave played wave 2 with 18-tick shots.

Start on the title removed the save (saved false, no Continue next run); lost and won runs removed it; Title from the pause kept it. But Start on the title shown after pause->Title did not remove the save: it opened the saved run's shop.
Won run with 1540: won screen 'Best: 1,540', title 'Best: 1,540', next process too (kept.best 1540); a later lost run with 0 left best 1540, lost screen showed 'Best: 1,540'.
Two runs seed 5 from identical copies of a kept folder, same script: identical output (md5 1b3ea8f3...); seed 6 put the enemies in other lanes; seeds 1 and 2 from fresh differ too.

Frame at wave 8 tick 1000: gate bar at the left, blue guard at y 8.3, white bolts at y 8.3 at the listed x, green walkers, small yellow runners, large red brutes at the listed positions; HUD 'Score: 1,000 Coins: 0 Wave 8 of 8 Gate: 10'.

Frames: Spanish title with Continuar outlined (menu_index 1), French settings with 'Difficulté : Normal' outlined, English shop with Mason outlined; all in the chosen language. (A second button is always filled blue, see defects.)
assets/strings/en.json, es.json, fr.json are the string tables, the ui files refer to keys ('@title.start'); README 'Adding a language' says how to add one.

README gives keys and rules, says the kept values are in FOLDER/settings.json (kept.best, kept.run, settings), and its two commands ran as written from the scratch folder (JSON printed; 800x480 frame written).

defects: Escape in the shop (and on the won/lost screens) opens a hidden engine pause: the next Enter is swallowed and a purchase is not made (Escape then Enter on Quick hands left coins 35; only the second Enter bought). The brief says Escape does nothing in the shop. The engine also warns that paused.json is drawn under shop/won.
Title from the pause leads to an engine 'bounce' screen: screen value not in the brief's list, its Start continues a saved run, and the previous run's enemies stay in the printed state.
In the menu frames a second button (Start on the title, Next wave in the shop) is always filled blue while the chosen entry only has an outline, so the mark is ambiguous.
Numbers in texts use thousands separators ('Best: 1,540', French '1 660') where the brief shows 'Best: 120'; harmless but differs from the brief's form.
Language and difficulty stop at the ends of their lists rather than cycling; allowed by the list item but noted.

trace.how: context, new, read_again and how far the context grew are the run's own records. written_out a request is its growth less its answers (characters / 4), scaled to the run's exact total; of_which_unseen is that less the visible text (thinking). cost is what the request read and wrote, weighted; carried is what reading again what it added cost at every later request (start.carried: the same for what every request starts from). reading + writing is in_the_ledger
